sourceRefs.locator: pp. 69–73, introduction and “The itinerary of Alaric”: campaign in Achaea in 396, Athens, Corinth and the disagreements among ancient accounts.
V.5–7: Alaric in southern Greece, Athens and passage to the Peloponnese.
V.37–42, especially V.39.1: Rome’s approaches and the supply link on the Tiber in the first siege; V.48–51: renewed negotiations.
Extract: Italian campaign from 408, shifting alliances, rupture of negotiations, sack of Rome in August 410.

summary.de: Die Personen, die unter Alarich zogen oder kämpften, kamen aus mehreren Verbänden. Der Name des Anführers verbindet die belegten Episoden; die Zusammensetzung blieb in Bewegung.
summary.en: People who travelled and fought under Alaric came from several groups. Their leader links the documented episodes; the composition of his following changed.
